rows.role_title: President of the Indian National Congress
rows.text: The INC's resolution on its 116th Foundation Day, 28 December 2000, says the party had invited Smt. Sonia Gandhi to head the Congress family, that she had been 're-elected ... as the Congress President by a near unanimous majority', and that the INC, 'under the dynamic leadership of Smt. Sonia Gandhi', renews its pledge.
